blocks.text: Scopes help you better manage your tenants and admins in the Zscaler Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners. Zscaler partners can create unique scopes that cover multiple tenants across various clouds and assign them to specific admins as required. Admins can view and manage tenants solely within their assigned scope.

For partners who have migrated to Authentication Service, the Authentication Service Admin Portal manages all scope and role assignments. To assign scopes and roles to admins, go to Administration > Entitlements > Partner Portal in the Authentication Service Admin Portal.
The Scopes page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Create a new scope with multi-tenant and multi-cloud settings.

blocks.text: On the Scopes page, you can do the following:

blocks.item: View the list of scopes in your partner account. For each scope, you can see:
Scope Name: The name of the scope.
No. of Tenants: Number of tenants covered by the scope.
Actions: Edit and delete options for each scope.
